author: Vinicius Carida
governing_principles: Decision-first: Prediction, simulation, intervention, and planning are measured distinctly with their own evidence standards and never collapsed into a single score.
Anti-tuning mandate: No model hyperparameters, thresholds, or structural equations may be tuned to make EWM win.
Negative results are first-class deliverables: Conditions where traditional ML or simple rules match or beat EWM on accuracy, regret, or cost-efficiency must be reported prominently.

hypotheses.null_hypothesis: Explicit 4-layer cascade dynamics + causal intervention (Rung 5) achieves no lower decision regret than observational ML (Rungs 2-3) or myopic rules when selecting joint (auth_threshold, staffed_agents, step_up_sms) policies under a fraud wave.
hypotheses.prediction: Rung 5 achieves significantly lower decision regret than Rungs 1-3 and myopic baselines when the policy intervention excites cross-departmental feedback (Fraud Gateway -> Contact Center -> Churn).

hypotheses.null_hypothesis: Full EWM (Rung 5) strictly dominates Gradient Boosted Trees with engineered lag/utilization features (Rung 3) on 1-step observational prediction MAE.
hypotheses.prediction: NEGATIVE RESULT FOR EWM: Standard ML with engineered features (Rung 3) matches or beats Rung 5 on 1-step observational prediction error at lower specification and compute cost.

hypotheses.null_hypothesis: Full EWM with causal do() surgery (Rung 5) outperforms an explicit-dynamics simulator without intervention machinery (Rung 4) on passive state simulation under a fixed policy.
hypotheses.prediction: NEGATIVE RESULT FOR EWM: Rung 4 (predict-only dynamics / conventional DES) achieves identical passive trajectory fidelity to Rung 5.

hypotheses.null_hypothesis: Improvements in 1-step observational prediction MAE monotonically reduce policy decision regret.
hypotheses.prediction: PREDICTION-VS-DECISION GAP: Moving from Rung 1 to Rung 3 reduces 1-step prediction MAE by >50% while yielding zero reduction in decision regret under confounded policy shifts; conversely, a structural model with an unmodeled constant cost offset exhibits worse state prediction MAE yet achieves zero decision regret.

hypotheses.null_hypothesis: Full EWM (Rung 5) is cost-justified in stationary single-department regimes without policy-induced cascades.
hypotheses.prediction: NEGATIVE RESULT FOR EWM: In stationary regimes without mid-rollout shifts or multi-hop cascades, Rung 5 incurs >3x higher latency and >4x higher specification complexity for zero net decision benefit.

hypotheses.null_hypothesis: An exact world model (Rung 5) guarantees low enterprise regret regardless of whether the planner's objective omits downstream SLA or churn LTV costs.
hypotheses.prediction: CONSTRUCT-VALIDITY FAILURE: Optimizing a narrow fraud-only KPI or short-horizon cash KPI inside the exact ground-truth world model produces high true enterprise regret (>$40,000).

statistical_protocol.multiplicity_correction: Holm-Bonferroni step-down across ladder comparisons per capability metric
